Of the only three regions on Earth with no native corvids — the poles, the southern tip of South America, and one island nation — which island nation is it?
questions.explanation: New Zealand, along with the poles and the southern part of South America, is one of only three places on Earth where no corvids (the family including crows, ravens, and jays) are native. This is notable because corvids are otherwise found on every continent and in nearly every habitat worldwide. New Zealand's geographic isolation has resulted in many unique absences and adaptations in its wildlife.
